findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contraband_incidents, search_site, get_page, list_intelligence · Private data: get_facility, get_mortality_data, get_settlements_data, get_gps_guide · Public sink: get_length_of_stay.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contraband_incidents, search_site, get_page, list_intelligence · Private data: get_facility, get_mortality_data, get_settlements_data, get_gps_guide · Public sink: get_length_of_stay

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
